Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142
linkedin.com/in/maya-linden-example

October 20, 2026

Coinbase

Application for Experiential Marketing Associate

Dear Coinbase team,

Coinbase needs events that turn the crypto community into customers, and that takes someone who can fill a room and then show what the room delivered. At the Westbrook Film Society, I raised average ticket sales from 35 to 60 per screening with a weekly "pick of the week" reel. I also helped plan a weekend adoption event at Harbor Street Pet Supply that brought in about 300 visitors.

I'm early in my career, and I bring the groundwork your Experiential Marketing Associate role builds on. I spent two years running the society's Instagram and TikTok accounts, where I trained two new volunteers and learned to hold quality steady while work piled up. At Harbor Street, I tracked results in Instagram Insights, Google Analytics and Excel, which prepared me for the post-event reporting on attendance and engagement that your team relies on. I also write copy and design in Canva and CapCut, so I can support invitations, signage and branded materials for on-site activations.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can support your experiential marketing calendar across Consumer and Institutional audiences. I'm available to start whenever suits your team and can set up a call at your convenience.

Best regards,
Maya Linden

job.title: Experiential Marketing Associate
requiredSkills: 2+ years of experience in event management or experiential marketing
Maintaining quality and meeting deadlines across overlapping timelines
Event management platforms (e.g., Splash, Eventbrite, Cvent)
Post-event reporting with measurable outcomes (attendance targets, engagement rates, attribution to leads and revenue)
Responsible use of generative AI with human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and improve workflow efficiency, cost, and quality
responsibilities: Own end-to-end event execution across Coinbase's experiential marketing calendar, managing venue sourcing, vendor coordination, contract negotiation, budgets, and attendee management
Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product, and Communications to align event programming with business priorities and ensure seamless delivery
Build and maintain event project plans, timelines, and run-of-show documents, tracking milestones from pre-event planning through post-event wrap-up
Support creative development for event experiences, collaborating with design and brand teams on invitations, signage, branded materials, and on-site activations
Track event budgets, manage vendor invoices, and reconcile expenses to keep programs within approved spend
Measure event performance by compiling post-event reports with attendance data, engagement metrics, and attribution to pipeline or revenue goals
job.expectedSalary: $100,725–$118,500 USD annual base salary (excluding equity and bonus)
